entry_qualification: 10th pass with Science and Mathematics (or equivalent)
stage_sequence: 10th Pass -> ITI Electrician (NCVT/DGT CTS 2.0, NSQF Level 4, 2 years) -> National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (DGT/NAPS, 1-2 years, leads to National Apprenticeship Certificate) -> Industrial Electrician (2-4 years shop-floor experience) -> Automation Technician (short-term upskilling in PLC/mechatronics via SSC-aligned QPs, e.g. IASC PLC Technician, ESSCI Mechatronics Maintenance Specialist) -> PLC Engineer -> Automation Consultant/Freelance
skills_required_summary: Electrical wiring and maintenance, motor control, industrial safety, PLC ladder logic programming, SCADA/HMI basics, panel wiring, troubleshooting, client-facing consulting skills at the top stage
certifications_involved: National Trade Certificate (NTC, NCVT/DGT) for Electrician; National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC); private/SSC short-course certificates in PLC & Automation (e.g. PLC Technician QP, IASC; Mechatronics Maintenance Specialist QP, ESSCI)
typical_duration: 8-12 years total (2 yrs ITI + 1-2 yrs apprenticeship + 2-4 yrs experience + 1-2 yrs upskilling + several years to reach consultant level)
exit_outcomes: Industrial electrician in manufacturing/utilities; automation/PLC technician or engineer in factories; independent automation consultant or panel-building contractor
data_source: DGT/NCVET Electrician CTS 2.0 Qualification File; DGT apprenticeship (NAPS) framework; IASC Sector Skill Council PLC Technician QP; ESSCI Qualification Packs
notes: This is the brief's own worked example, refined after verification. [stage_sequence/NSQF level]: sources conflict on the NSQF level for Electrician -- the current DGT/NCVET CTS 2.0 Qualification File (2022) is titled/filed as NSQF Level 4, while several ITI-directory and secondary sources describe the (older, pre-CTS-2.0 or 2-year composite) Electrician course as NSQF Level 5; both figures appear in circulation and could not be fully reconciled from available sources -- flagged for human review. [stage_sequence]: 'Automation Technician/PLC Engineer/Automation Consultant' stages are a genuinely observed real-world ladder reported by industry/ITI career sources but are not governed by a single DGT-mandated progression QP the way Electrician->Apprenticeship is; PLC/automation upskilling is typically via separate short-term SSC-aligned or private courses rather than a mandatory next NCVET qualification.

path_name: ITI Welder to Fabrication Business Owner
stage_sequence: 10th Pass -> ITI Welder (Fabrication & Fitting) (NCVT/DGT CTS 2.0, NSQF Level 3, 1 year/1200 hrs + 150 hrs OJT) -> DGT Apprenticeship (NAPS, ~1 year, National Apprenticeship Certificate) -> Welder/Fabricator (2-3 years industry experience in construction, manufacturing or shipbuilding) -> Senior/Certified Welder (advanced welding process certifications) -> Fabrication Workshop Supervisor -> Fabrication Business Owner/Contractor (self-employment, often financed via PMEGP/MUDRA)
skills_required_summary: Arc/gas/MIG/TIG welding techniques, metal fitting and fabrication, reading engineering drawings, welding inspection basics, workshop safety, and business/costing skills at the entrepreneurial stage
certifications_involved: National Trade Certificate (NTC, NCVT/DGT) for Welder (Fabrication & Fitting); National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC); optional advanced welding/inspection certificates from private institutes
typical_duration: 6-10 years total (1 yr ITI + ~1 yr apprenticeship + 2-3 yrs experience + several years to accumulate capital/clients for business ownership)
exit_outcomes: Welder/fabricator in construction, automotive or manufacturing; workshop supervisor; self-employed fabrication contractor or small workshop owner
data_source: DGT/NCVT Welder (Fabrication & Fitting) CTS 2.0 Qualification File; ITI trade guides describing self-employment outcomes
notes: [stage_sequence/NSQF level]: the official DGT CTS 2.0 qualification file for Welder (Fabrication & Fitting) is filed as NSQF Level 3, while some secondary sources describe the Welder trade generally as NSQF Level 4 -- both values appear in circulation; Level 3 (from the primary DGT document) used here but flagged for review. [stage_sequence]: 'Fabrication Business Owner/Contractor' is a genuinely common, industry-observed self-employment outcome explicitly named in DGT course-objective text ('self-employment in welding and fabrication services') but is not itself a certified qualification stage -- no NCVET QP governs the transition from welder to business owner, so this segment is qualitative/entrepreneurial rather than Tier-1 documented.

path_name: ITI Turner/Machinist to CNC Machine Shop Supervisor
stage_sequence: 10th Pass -> ITI Turner or Machinist (NCVT/DGT CTS, NSQF Level 4-5, 2 years) -> DGT Apprenticeship (NAPS) -> Machine Operator (conventional lathe/milling, shop-floor experience) -> CNC Machinist 3-Axis (Short-Term Course, NSQF Level 5, 960 hours, entry requires ITI pass in Machinist/Machinist Grinder/Turner/Operator Advanced Machine Tool) -> Lead Machinist/CNC Programmer -> Machine Shop Supervisor (via experience or CITS instructor route)
skills_required_summary: Precision machining, lathe/milling operation, metrology and measurement, CNC part-program reading and G-code basics, tool selection, quality control, and team supervision at the top stage
certifications_involved: National Trade Certificate (NTC, NCVT/DGT) for Turner/Machinist; National Apprenticeship Certificate; CNC Machinist 3-Axis Short-Term Course certificate (NSQF Level 5); optional Craft Instructor Training Scheme (CITS) certificate for supervisory/instructor track
typical_duration: 7-12 years total (2 yrs ITI + ~1 yr apprenticeship + 2-4 yrs experience + short CNC course + several years to reach supervisor level)
exit_outcomes: CNC operator/programmer in automotive, aerospace or general manufacturing; shift/machine shop supervisor; shop-floor engineering manager
data_source: DGT/NCVT Turner and Machinist CTS Qualification Files; CNC Machinist 3-Axis Short-Term Course Qualification File; Bharat Skills CITS Machinist & Operator Advance Machine Tool curriculum
notes: [entry_qualification/stage_sequence]: base ITI Turner/Machinist NSQF level cited as a 4-5 range because different DGT documents and secondary sources give slightly different levels for these long-standing trades; the CNC Machinist 3-Axis short-term course itself is confirmed at NSQF Level 5. [stage_sequence]: 'Machine Shop Supervisor' progression (line leader -> supervisor -> shop foreman/manager) is a widely and consistently industry-documented ladder but relies on experience and internal promotion rather than a single further NCVET qualification, aside from the optional CITS instructor route.

path_name: Digital Marketing Freelancer to Agency Owner
entry_qualification: 12th pass or graduate (no formal minimum mandated; most entrants have basic computer literacy)
stage_sequence: 12th Pass/Graduate -> Digital Marketing Assistant (NSDC/Media & Entertainment Skills Council, short-term NSQF-aligned QP) -> Social Media & Digital Marketing Executive (on-the-job skill building in SEO, ads, analytics) -> Digital Marketing Manager (Media & Entertainment Skills Council QP, NSQF Level 6, requires ~3 years work experience) -> Independent Freelance Digital Marketer -> Digital Marketing Agency Owner
skills_required_summary: SEO, social media management, paid ads (Google/Meta), content creation, analytics/reporting, client acquisition and management, and team-building/business operations at the agency-owner stage
certifications_involved: NSDC/Skill India Digital Hub course certificates for Digital Marketing Assistant/Executive; Media & Entertainment Skills Council Digital Marketing Manager QP (NSQF Level 6); numerous private-platform certifications (Google Ads, Google Analytics, Meta Blueprint) that are industry-standard but not NCVET-governed
typical_duration: 5-8 years total (short course + 3+ years experience to reach manager/freelance level + additional years to build an agency)
exit_outcomes: In-house digital marketing executive/manager; independent freelance consultant; founder of a small digital marketing agency
data_source: NSDC/Skill India Digital Hub course listings; Media & Entertainment Skills Council (MESC) Digital Marketing Manager Qualification File and Model Curriculum
notes: [stage_sequence]: only the early-to-mid stages (Digital Marketing Assistant through Digital Marketing Manager, NSQF Level 6) are backed by an NCVET-recognized qualification file; the 'freelancer' and 'agency owner' stages are genuinely common, widely observed real-world career outcomes in this field but are not certified or tracked by any Sector Skill Council progression map -- this segment is qualitative/entrepreneurial (Tier 5) and confidence is scored accordingly, well below the Tier-1 stages.

path_name: Solar PV Installer (Suryamitra) to Solar EPC Entrepreneur
entry_qualification: 8th/10th pass (ITI in Electrician/Fitter or equivalent preferred by many training centres)
stage_sequence: 8th/10th Pass -> Suryamitra Skill Development Programme (National Institute of Solar Energy/MNRE, ~3 months residential/600 hours, aligned to Solar PV Installer QP SGJ/Q0101, Skill Council for Green Jobs) -> Solar PV Installer/Service Technician (field installation and O&M experience) -> Senior Solar Technician/Site Supervisor -> Solar EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) Entrepreneur or Small Solar Business Owner
skills_required_summary: Solar PV system design basics, panel and inverter installation, wiring and earthing, battery/BOS components, operation and maintenance, plus the programme's built-in entrepreneurship and soft-skills module for the business-owner stage
certifications_involved: Suryamitra Skill Development Programme certificate (NISE/MNRE, NSDC-affiliated training centres, aligned to QP SGJ/Q0101); no separate NCVET QP identified for the EPC-entrepreneur stage
typical_duration: 4-8 years total (3-month training + several years of field experience before starting an independent EPC business)
exit_outcomes: Solar PV installation/O&M technician for residential and commercial rooftop or utility-scale projects; site supervisor; independent solar EPC contractor
data_source: National Institute of Solar Energy (NISE) Suryamitra Skill Development Programme; Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) Skill Development Programme page; NSDC Solar PV Installer (Suryamitra) listing
notes: [entry_qualification]: exact minimum entry qualification and age criteria for Suryamitra intake could not be independently confirmed from available (non-.gov.in-fetchable) sources beyond general programme descriptions; 8th/10th pass is the commonly cited minimum across secondary sources. [stage_sequence]: the entrepreneurship/EPC-business stage is explicitly part of the programme's stated objective ('prepare the participant to become an entrepreneur in the solar energy sector') but is not governed by a distinct NCVET qualification, so this final stage is qualitative rather than certification-backed.

stage_sequence: 10th Pass -> ITI Fitter (NCVT/DGT CTS 2.0, NSQF Level 4, 2 years) -> DGT Apprenticeship (NAPS, 1-2 years, National Apprenticeship Certificate) -> Fitter/Production Fitter (2-4 years shop-floor experience) -> Senior Fitter/Line Leader -> Manufacturing Supervisor (via experience, or Craft Instructor Training Scheme/CITS route to become an ITI instructor, or lateral entry into a Diploma in Engineering)
skills_required_summary: Fitting, assembly, precision measurement, use of hand and machine tools, reading engineering drawings, production-line quality control, and team supervision at the top stage
certifications_involved: National Trade Certificate (NTC, NCVT/DGT) for Fitter; National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC); optional Craft Instructor Training Scheme (CITS) certificate or lateral-entry engineering diploma
typical_duration: 7-11 years total (2 yrs ITI + 1-2 yrs apprenticeship + 3-5 yrs experience to reach supervisor level)
exit_outcomes: Production fitter/assembler in manufacturing plants; line leader or shift supervisor; ITI instructor (via CITS); diploma-holder engineer via lateral entry
data_source: DGT/NCVT Fitter CTS 2.0 Qualification File; DGT presentation on apprenticeship progression options
notes: [stage_sequence/NSQF level]: the current DGT CTS 2.0 Qualification File for Fitter is filed at NSQF Level 4, while some secondary/older sources describe the Fitter trade as NSQF Level 5 or 6 (the latter figure applies to the separate CITS Fitter instructor-training qualification, not the base ITI trade) -- flagged for review to avoid conflating the base trade with the instructor-level qualification.

path_name: Food Processing Technician to FPO Manager
stage_sequence: 8th/10th Pass -> Multi-Skill Technician (Food Processing) (Food Industry Capacity & Skill Initiative/FICSI, NCVET-approved QP) -> Food Processing Line Technician/Quality Checker (shop-floor experience in a processing unit) -> Senior Technician/Production-in-Charge -> Farmer Producer Organisation (FPO) Manager or CEO (via NABARD/SFAC-facilitated capacity-building training for FPO staff)
skills_required_summary: Sorting, grading, cleaning and processing of fruits/vegetables, food safety and hygiene (HACCP basics), basic quality testing, and at the FPO-manager stage: procurement, farmer aggregation, business planning, accounts and value-chain/market linkage skills
certifications_involved: FICSI-issued Multi-Skill Technician (Food Processing) qualification certificate; no distinct NCVET-recognized qualification/QP identified specifically for the 'FPO Manager' role -- NABARD/SFAC and state agencies run non-certifying capacity-building training programmes for FPO CEOs/Boards of Directors
typical_duration: 6-10 years total (short-term technician training + several years of processing-unit and value-chain experience before moving into FPO management)
exit_outcomes: Line technician/quality checker in a food processing unit; production supervisor; FPO manager/CEO handling farmer aggregation, processing and market linkage
data_source: Food Industry Capacity & Skill Initiative (FICSI) Multi-Skill Technician (Food Processing) NCVET-approved Qualification File; NABARD paper on Farmer Producer Organisations (Status & Issues)
notes: [certifications_involved / stage_sequence]: the 'FPO Manager' end-stage is a genuine, real-world career destination documented in NABARD/SFAC materials on FPO capacity building, but no NCVET-recognized qualification pack specifically certifies 'FPO Manager' as a job role -- training for this stage is delivered as non-certifying capacity-building by NABARD, SFAC, state departments and Cluster-Based Business Organisations (CBBOs), so this stage is qualitative (Tier 4) rather than Tier-1 QP-backed, and the confidence score reflects that gap.

entry_qualification: No formal minimum education mandated; commonly 8th/10th pass entrants
stage_sequence: 8th/10th Pass (or no formal minimum) -> Self Employed Tailor training (Apparel Made-ups & Home Furnishing Sector Skill Council/AMHSSC, Qualification Pack AMH/Q1947 v3.0, NCVET-approved) -> Home-based/Freelance Tailor (measurement-taking, cutting, stitching for local clientele) -> Boutique Assistant/Junior Designer (optional stage, working under an established boutique) -> Boutique Owner (independent retail/custom-stitching business)
skills_required_summary: Garment measurement and pattern making, cutting, machine and hand stitching, finishing and embellishment, basic customer service, and at the boutique-owner stage: pricing, inventory and small-business management
certifications_involved: Self Employed Tailor Qualification Pack certificate (AMHSSC, AMH/Q1947, NSQF-aligned, NCVET-approved 24th NSQC meeting, 17-11-2022)
typical_duration: 3-6 years total (short-term QP-aligned training + several years building a client base before opening a boutique)
exit_outcomes: Home-based/freelance tailor; boutique or custom-stitching business owner; employment as a skilled tailor in a garment unit or boutique
data_source: Apparel Made-ups & Home Furnishing Sector Skill Council (AMHSSC) Self Employed Tailor NSQF Qualification File
notes: This is one of the better-documented entrepreneurial pathways in this dataset: the AMHSSC 'Self Employed Tailor' QP is explicitly designed and NCVET-approved for a self-employment/livelihood outcome, so the tailor-to-boutique-owner trajectory is directly named in the qualification's own scope rather than being an external inference.

path_name: Drone Pilot to Drone Survey Business Owner
stage_sequence: 10th Pass (age 18+) -> DGCA-authorized Remote Pilot Training Organisation (RPTO) course (5-6 days, covers theory and practical flying) -> DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC) via eGCA portal (drone registration/UIN, assessment) -> Commercial Drone Pilot (agriculture spraying/mapping, infrastructure or crop-monitoring surveys; may operate under schemes such as Namo Drone Didi for women-led SHGs) -> Senior/Certified Surveying Drone Pilot -> Drone Survey Business Owner (independent drone services/survey company)
skills_required_summary: Drone flight operation and safety, airspace regulations and UIN/RPC compliance, GPS-based mapping/surveying software, basic data processing (orthomosaic/point-cloud outputs for survey work), and business development at the owner stage
certifications_involved: DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC), issued after RPTO training and assessment via the eGCA portal; no distinct NCVET/SSC qualification pack for the 'survey business owner' stage was confirmed in available sources
typical_duration: 3-6 years total (under 2 weeks of formal RPTO training/RPC certification + several years building commercial flying experience and clients before establishing an independent survey business)
exit_outcomes: Commercial drone pilot for agriculture, mapping, or infrastructure-inspection clients; salaried drone operator; independent drone survey/services business owner
data_source: DGCA drone licensing process as described by industry RPTO training providers (primary DGCA/eGCA government pages could not be directly fetched due to access restrictions on .gov.in domains)
notes: [data_source/source_url]: direct DGCA/eGCA government documentation could not be fetched (WebFetch to .gov.in domains returns 403 in this environment); the RPC process and entry requirements described here are drawn from industry RPTO training-provider websites describing the government-mandated process, which is a lower-tier secondary source than a primary DGCA circular even though the underlying regulatory facts (RPC requirement, eGCA portal, age/education minimums) are consistent across multiple such sources. [stage_sequence]: 'Drone Survey Business Owner' is a genuinely observed and rapidly growing real-world outcome (agri-drone and survey services) but is not itself a certified qualification stage -- no NCVET/SSC QP for this specific business-owner role was located.

entry_qualification: 12th pass (with computer background), or 10th pass with 2 years relevant experience
stage_sequence: 12th Pass (or 10th Pass + 2 yrs experience) -> Technical Support Executive/Customer Care Associate (IT-ITeS Sector Skill Council/NASSCOM Qualification Pack, e.g. SSC/Q... Technical Support Executive, NSQF Level 4) -> Senior Associate (voice/non-voice process, 1-2 years experience) -> Technical Support Engineer (higher NOS-count IT-ITeS SSC QP, added technical depth) -> Team Leader (internal promotion based on performance and experience, no distinct NCVET QP identified for this specific title) -> Assistant Manager/Operations Manager
skills_required_summary: Voice/non-voice customer handling, English/communication skills, CRM and ticketing-tool usage, basic troubleshooting (for technical support roles), process compliance, and at the team-lead stage: team coaching, shift scheduling and performance-metric management
certifications_involved: IT-ITeS Sector Skill Council (NASSCOM) Technical Support Executive/Engineer Qualification Pack certificates (NSQF Level 4 and above); Team Leader progression is typically an internal, experience-based promotion rather than a separate certified qualification
typical_duration: 3-6 years total (entry QP-aligned training/on-boarding + 2-4 years of performance-based promotion to team lead)
exit_outcomes: Customer support/technical support associate; senior associate or subject-matter expert; team leader; assistant manager in BPO/BPM operations
data_source: IT-ITeS Sector Skill Council (NASSCOM) Technical Support Executive and Technical Support Engineer Qualification Packs and Participant Handbooks
notes: [stage_sequence/certifications_involved]: a specific NASSCOM/IT-ITeS SSC Qualification Pack for a 'Team Leader' job role in domestic BPO voice process could not be confirmed within the available search budget for this collection run (web search quota was exhausted mid-research); the Associate->Team Leader->Manager ladder itself is extremely widely and consistently documented as the standard BPO/BPM industry career path (Tier 5, qualitative/industry-observed), but the exact QP code for team-lead-level certification remains unverified and needs a follow-up source check -- noted here rather than in a dedicated cell because the overall pathway, not one single field value, is what is unresolved.

entry_qualification: No formal minimum for entry-level roles; typically 10th/12th pass
stage_sequence: 10th/12th Pass -> Retail Store Operations Assistant (RASCI Qualification Pack, NSQF Level 2) -> Retail Sales Associate/Sales Assistant/Cashier (RASCI QPs, NSQF Level 3) -> Retail Team Leader (RASCI QP, NSQF Level 4.5) -> Deputy Manager, Retail Store Department (RASCI QP, NSQF Level 5, requires 12th pass + 3 years relevant experience, or NSQF Level 4 qualification + 3 years experience) -> Retail Store Manager (RASCI QP, NSQF Level 7, requires 12th/ITI + 4 years supervisory experience in store operations)
skills_required_summary: Customer service, point-of-sale/cashier operations, merchandising and stock management, team supervision, sales-target management, and at the top stages: P&L accountability, staff scheduling and store-level business management
certifications_involved: Retailers Association's Skill Council of India (RASCI) Qualification Pack certificates at each level: Retail Store Operations Assistant (NSQF 2), Retail Sales Associate (NSQF 3), Retail Team Leader (NSQF 4.5), Deputy Manager-Retail Store Department (NSQF 5), Retail Store Manager (NSQF 7)
typical_duration: 7-12 years total to progress through all five RASCI-defined levels from entry associate to store manager, based on the stated minimum experience requirements at each level
exit_outcomes: Retail sales associate/cashier; retail team leader/supervisor; deputy store manager; full store manager responsible for a retail outlet's operations and P&L
data_source: Retailers Association's Skill Council of India (RASCI) Qualification Packs, adopted by NCVET (Office Order: Adoption of 20 Qualifications of RASCI)
notes: One of the most fully Tier-1-documented pathways in this dataset: RASCI publishes a coherent, explicitly leveled NSQF ladder (2 -> 3 -> 4.5 -> 5 -> 7) with named QPs and stated entry/experience criteria for every stage, and these qualifications are formally NCVET-adopted, which supports the higher end of the confidence range used in this dataset.

path_name: Hospitality Service Staff to Restaurant Manager
stage_sequence: 10th/12th Pass -> Food & Beverage Service Steward (Tourism and Hospitality Skill Council/THSC Qualification Pack THC/Q0301, NSQF Level 4) -> Food & Beverage Service Assistant/Associate (THSC QP THC/Q0307) -> Senior Steward/Captain (experience-based) -> Food & Beverage Service Manager (THSC Qualification Pack THC/Q0303) -> Restaurant Manager
skills_required_summary: Table service and guest handling, order-taking and POS systems, food safety/hygiene basics, menu knowledge, and at the manager stage: staff scheduling, inventory/cost control and guest-experience management
certifications_involved: Tourism and Hospitality Skill Council (THSC) Qualification Pack certificates: Food & Beverage Service Steward (THC/Q0301), Food & Beverage Service Assistant (THC/Q0307), Food & Beverage Service Manager (THC/Q0303)
typical_duration: 6-10 years total to progress from entry-level steward to restaurant/F&B service manager
exit_outcomes: Food and beverage service steward/waiter; captain/senior steward; restaurant or food-and-beverage service manager in hotels, restaurants or catering operations
data_source: Tourism and Hospitality Skill Council (THSC) Qualification Packs for Food & Beverage Service roles
notes: [stage_sequence]: THSC's own QP titles use 'Food & Beverage Service Manager' rather than 'Restaurant Manager'; these are treated here as substantially equivalent roles in common industry usage, but the exact scope/seniority mapping between the THSC-defined role and a generic 'Restaurant Manager' title was not independently confirmed and may vary by establishment.

path_name: ITI Plumber to Independent Plumbing Contractor
stage_sequence: 10th Pass -> ITI Plumber (NCVT/DGT CTS, NSQF Level 3 or 4 depending on curriculum version, 1-2 years) -> DGT Apprenticeship (NAPS) -> Plumber (residential/commercial installation and repair experience) -> Senior/Certified Plumber (pipe-fitting, water-supply and drainage systems specialization) -> Independent Plumbing Contractor (self-employment, informal or small-registered business)
skills_required_summary: Pipe-fitting and jointing, water-supply and drainage system installation, reading plumbing layouts, use of plumbing tools, basic sanitary-fixture installation, and at the contractor stage: client management, material procurement and small-crew supervision
certifications_involved: National Trade Certificate (NTC, NCVT/DGT) for Plumber; National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC); no distinct NCVET qualification identified specifically for the 'independent contractor' stage
typical_duration: 6-10 years total (1-2 yrs ITI + apprenticeship + several years of field experience before operating independently as a contractor)
exit_outcomes: Plumber employed by a construction firm or maintenance department; independent/self-employed plumber; small plumbing contracting business owner
data_source: DGT/NCVT Plumber CTS and ATS Qualification Files (multiple curriculum versions at different NSQF levels)
notes: [stage_sequence/NSQF level]: available sources show multiple different NSQF levels (3, 4 and 5) attached to different versions/durations of the Plumber curriculum (1-year CTS vs 2-year ATS/other variants); this dataset could not fully reconcile which level applies to the standard current 10th-pass entry pathway, so a range (Level 3 or 4) is given with the 2-year Level-5 ATS variant noted as an alternative -- flagged for human review. [stage_sequence]: 'Independent Plumbing Contractor' is a genuinely common real-world outcome (most Indian plumbers work independently or in small crews) but is an informal/entrepreneurial stage with no governing NCVET qualification.

path_name: Healthcare Support Worker to Nursing Assistant Progression
stage_sequence: 10th/12th Pass -> General Duty Assistant (GDA) (Healthcare Sector Skill Council/HSSC Qualification Pack HSS/Q5101, NSQF Level 4) -> Advanced/Specialised GDA (critical care, dialysis or maternal-care specialization, on-the-job and short-course upskilling) -> Senior Patient Care Assistant/Team Lead (experience-based) -> ANM (Auxiliary Nurse Midwife) or GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery) via separate formal admission to a Nursing Council-recognized diploma programme (NOT an automatic progression from GDA)
skills_required_summary: Basic patient care, vital-signs monitoring, hygiene and infection control, mobility assistance, and at the specialized/senior stages: critical-care or maternal-care specific protocols and basic team coordination; ANM/GNM require full formal nursing education and clinical training, not just GDA experience
certifications_involved: General Duty Assistant Qualification Pack certificate (HSSC, HSS/Q5101, NSQF Level 4); separate Indian Nursing Council-recognized ANM/GNM diploma certificates for the final stage (obtained via independent formal admission, not a direct SSC-to-nursing bridge)
typical_duration: GDA course itself is typically several months to ~1 year; 2-4 years of GDA/patient-care experience before specialization; ANM/GNM route requires a separate 2-3.5 year formal diploma admitted independently of GDA status
exit_outcomes: General Duty Assistant/patient care attendant in hospitals, nursing homes or home healthcare; specialized (critical care/dialysis/maternal) care assistant; team lead/senior patient care coordinator; separately, ANM/GNM-qualified nursing professional for those who pursue formal nursing education
data_source: Healthcare Sector Skill Council (HSSC) General Duty Assistant Qualification Pack (HSS/Q5101); CBSE vocational curriculum documentation of the GDA job role
notes: [stage_sequence]: this pathway is deliberately worded to avoid overstating the GDA-to-ANM/GNM link -- ANM and GNM are separate, Indian Nursing Council-regulated formal education qualifications requiring their own independent admission and multi-year diploma study; GDA experience does not automatically confer entry or credit toward them, though some GDAs do go on to pursue ANM/GNM separately. The 'Advanced/Specialised GDA' stage (critical care, dialysis, maternal care) is described in secondary career-guide sources but a specific corresponding NCVET QP code for each specialization was not independently confirmed.

path_name: IT Support Technician to Cloud Engineer
entry_qualification: 12th pass with computer background, or 10th pass with 2 years relevant experience
stage_sequence: 12th Pass (or 10th Pass + 2 yrs experience) -> Technical Support Executive (IT-ITeS Sector Skill Council/NASSCOM Qualification Pack, NSQF Level 4) -> Technical Support Engineer (IT-ITeS SSC QP SSC/Q5101, broader NOS coverage) -> Desktop/Network Support Engineer (with private certifications such as CompTIA A+/Network+) -> Cloud Support Associate (industry-standard cloud-provider certifications, e.g. AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner/Azure Fundamentals) -> Cloud Engineer
skills_required_summary: Hardware/OS troubleshooting, networking fundamentals, ticketing-system and customer-support skills, and at the later stages: cloud infrastructure concepts (compute, storage, networking), virtualization, and cloud-provider-specific tools (AWS/Azure/GCP)
certifications_involved: IT-ITeS Sector Skill Council (NASSCOM) Technical Support Executive/Engineer Qualification Pack certificates (NSQF Level 4 and above) for the early stages; private industry certifications (CompTIA, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) for the later cloud-focused stages -- these are not NCVET-governed QPs
typical_duration: 5-9 years total (entry QP-aligned onboarding + several years of support experience + cloud certification study to transition into a cloud engineering role)
exit_outcomes: IT help-desk/technical support associate; desktop or network support engineer; cloud support associate; cloud engineer/administrator
data_source: IT-ITeS Sector Skill Council (NASSCOM) Technical Support Executive/Engineer Qualification Packs; MeitY-cleared cloud computing Qualification Packs referenced in IT-ITeS SSC emerging-technology offerings
notes: [stage_sequence/certifications_involved]: only the entry-level Technical Support Executive/Engineer stages are backed by confirmed NCVET-recognized IT-ITeS SSC Qualification Packs; the 'Cloud Support Associate' and 'Cloud Engineer' stages in real-world Indian IT careers are overwhelmingly reached via private vendor certifications (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) rather than a specific NCVET QP, and although MeitY has cleared some cloud-computing QPs, the exact QP-to-job-title mapping for this specific pathway could not be confirmed within the available research budget -- this is a genuinely observed industry pathway (Tier 4/5) rather than a single end-to-end NCVET-documented ladder.
